findings.claim: Migration crashes with IndexError when no site_settings row 'embed_category' matches a category (fresh installs, test DB, any site that kept the '' default); the category_id==0 fallback is never reached, and the uncategorized_category_id lookup at line 15 has the same unguarded [0] on a fresh DB.
findings.evidence: execute(...)[0]['id'] on an empty PG::Result; pg 0.18.1 (Gemfile.lock:220) raises IndexError on out-of-range row. Settings at default are not stored as rows. Line 19 uses the correct cmd_tuples>0 guard; migration 20140711193923 uses .first with nil check. Repro (reasoned, not run): RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rake db:drop db:create db:migrate.
findings.reason: Unanimous across all four seats; concrete repro command; blocks upgrades and fresh setups.

findings.claim: Legacy hosts are inserted verbatim via raw SQL, bypassing the model's scheme/path normalisation, so entries like 'http://eviltrout.com' or 'https://example.com/1234' (accepted by the old allows_embeddable_host?) never match record_for_host after upgrade and embedding silently breaks; trailing \r/whitespace from the textarea is also kept.
findings.evidence: Removed specs 'works with a http host'/'works with a https host' prove the old setting accepted schemes. record_for_host compares lower(host) = uri.host (embeddable_host.rb:17). Repro (reasoned): seed embeddable_hosts='http://eviltrout.com', migrate, EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?('http://eviltrout.com/x') => false.
findings.reason: Three correctness/standards seats agree; concrete repro; data-migration regression for existing sites.

findings.claim: Topics imported by feed polling (poll_feed.rb:39, typepad.thor:63) now take their category from the item's host record instead of the removed global embed_category setting; items whose host is not registered get category nil (Uncategorized), and admins lose any way to set the feed import category.
findings.evidence: eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url) at line 36; category: eh.try(:category_id) at line 43; embed_category setting deleted by the migration with no replacement for this path.
findings.reason: Behaviour regression for feed-import users; superpowers rated Important, OCR Minor; normalised to Important because existing configured behaviour is lost without replacement.

findings.claim: New create/update/destroy and embedding show endpoints have no behavioural tests; specs only assert subclassing AdminController, contrary to CONTRIBUTING 'include tests'. The nil-record and nil-host 500s and migration bugs are uncovered.
findings.evidence: Both new controller specs contain only an inheritance assertion.
findings.reason: Documented standard (CONTRIBUTING); normalised from Important (mattpocock) to Minor (superpowers) since it is a coverage gap, not a defect itself; guards for the accepted fixes belong here.

findings.claim: Host values are string-interpolated into SQL ('#{h}') without quoting; a value containing a single quote aborts the migration.
findings.evidence: VALUES ('#{h}', ...) in raw execute; source is an admin-only setting so injection risk is low.
findings.reason: Real but low-impact (admin-sourced data); ponytail flagged Important outside its axis, correctness seats Minor/embedded; trivial quote(h) fix.

findings.claim: Migration uses def change with raw execute data moves and deletes the old settings, so rollback raises IrreversibleMigration and old data is unrecoverable.
findings.evidence: def change + execute INSERT/DELETE at lines 18-31.
findings.reason: ponytail: irreversible data migrations are common in this codebase; add explicit up/down only if rollback support is required.

findings.claim: before_validation calls self.host.sub! on nil when no host param is given, raising NoMethodError (500) instead of a validation error; a missing params[:embeddable_host] also raises in the controller.
findings.evidence: self.host.sub! at lines 6-7; controller save_host passes params[:embeddable_host][:host] straight through (embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:23).
findings.reason: All four seats; admin-only so Minor; one-line guard.

findings.claim: Validation accepts a port (example.com:8080) but record_for_host compares against uri.host (no port), so such hosts never match; the [a-z]{2,5} TLD rule also rejects localhost, IPs and long TLDs that the old setting allowed, so migrated rows fail validation on later edit.
findings.evidence: Regex (:[0-9]{1,5})? at line 2; uri.host at line 14; migrated rows bypass validation via raw SQL.
findings.reason: Three seats agree; validation and lookup contract disagree.

findings.claim: The (\/.*)? path group in the validation regex is dead: before_validation strips everything from the first '/' first.
findings.evidence: before_validation sub!(/\/.*$/, '') at line 7 runs before validates_format_of.
findings.reason: Dead branch; trivial removal alongside the regex fix.

findings.claim: Case-insensitive lookup lowercases only the column, not uri.host, so http://EvilTrout.com/x fails to match via TopicRetriever (raw embed_url).
findings.evidence: where("lower(host) = ?", host) with host = uri.host un-downcased.
findings.reason: Two correctness seats; one-token fix (host.downcase).

findings.claim: No unique index on host and no uniqueness validation; duplicate hosts make record_for_host's .first pick a category arbitrarily.
findings.evidence: create_table has no index; model has no validates_uniqueness_of.
findings.reason: ponytail: admin-curated small table; add uniqueness when duplicates are observed or when touching the migration for the Critical fix.

findings.claim: category_id is NOT NULL but has no FK, no existence check in the controller, and no dependent handling; deleting a category leaves orphaned host rows that make imports silently uncategorized and render a blank admin badge.
findings.evidence: No FK in migration; belongs_to :category without dependent; save_host accepts any category_id.
findings.reason: ponytail: consistent with codebase convention of no DB FKs; revisit with category-deletion handling.

findings.claim: update/destroy use where(id:).first and then dereference, so an unknown id raises NoMethodError (500) instead of 404.
findings.evidence: host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first; host.destroy / save_host(host) at lines 10-16.
findings.reason: Three seats; EmbeddableHost.find gives RecordNotFound -> 404.

findings.claim: before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff duplicates filters already declared by the parent Admin::AdminController (also in embedding_controller.rb:3).
findings.evidence: app/controllers/admin/admin_controller.rb:3-4.
findings.reason: Pure duplication; delete.

findings.claim: Embedding#update persists nothing (re-renders show), the PUT customize/embedding route backs it, and the client saveChanges action is never referenced by any template: dead endpoint that looks like it saves.
findings.evidence: update body identical to show; grep saveChanges finds only admin-embedding.js.es6:5; embedding.hbs has no trigger.
findings.reason: Three seats; ponytail rated Important, normalised to Minor (dead code, no user-visible fault); delete update, route and action.

findings.claim: The Embedding wrapper (OpenStruct with id 'default', its own controller, serializer, adapter, routes) plus the new plural _ids store hydration exist only to wrap a host list; an index action on EmbeddableHostsController with store.findAll('embeddable-host') (pattern in admin-plugins.js.es6:3) would remove ~60 lines.
findings.evidence: admin-plugins route uses this.store.findAll; resources :embeddable_hosts already routed.
findings.reason: ponytail: advisory design call; wrapper may be intended to carry future embed settings. Advisory seats never block.

findings.claim: Explicit id/host/category_id methods only return object.<attr>; attributes declaration already does this. File also ends with an extra blank line.
findings.evidence: permalink_serializer.rb:2 declares the same attributes with no pass-through methods.
findings.reason: Delete 12 redundant lines.

findings.claim: New _ids hydration branch deletes the *_ids key even when no sideloaded collection exists (leaving an array of undefined), throws TypeError on a null *_ids value, and 'hydrated || []' is dead since map always returns an array; unlike the singular _id branch there is no hydrated guard.
findings.evidence: Lines 197-201 vs 203-205; no current rest_serializer endpoint emits _ids so not live yet (superpowers).
findings.reason: All four seats; latent footgun in shared store code.

findings.claim: type.replace('_', '-') replaces only the first underscore, so a future admin model with two underscores resolves the wrong base path.
findings.evidence: String.prototype.replace with a string pattern replaces once.
findings.reason: Trivial /_/g fix.

findings.claim: Saving a new host without touching the category chooser shows a blank category badge until reload (client uses findById(null), server substitutes uncategorized); destroyRecord() at line 46 has no .catch(popupAjaxError) so delete errors are swallowed.
findings.evidence: Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')) with null categoryId; controller line 26 uses uncategorized_category_id.
findings.reason: Two seats; small UI correctness fix.

findings.claim: admin.embedding.edit locale key is never referenced (component uses an icon without label).
findings.evidence: grep 'embedding.edit' in app/assets finds nothing.
findings.reason: Unused string; delete.

findings.claim: Inner 'if records.present?' is redundant after val.present? and split.

findings.reason: Trivial, folded into the migration rewrite for the Critical fix.

findings.claim: Contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped: category fabricators now live in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb and :embeddable_host in category_fabricator.rb; a 4-line addition became a 54-line move.

findings.claim: Scope beyond the commit message: embeddable_hosts/embed_category site settings removed (breaks external scripts that set them), expandable_first_post? no longer requires configured hosts, and unrelated unused-variable cleanups in spec/models/topic_spec.rb:1241,1250.
